headline: Western Front Bases Shift Amid Surge in Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the western arc remains the hottest sector. Deadlands recorded two fresh ownership flips in the past two hours and five in six, keeping its daily turnover near sixteen. Stlican Shelf added three new turns in the last two hours and three in six, sustaining a daily tally of thirty. Weathered Expanse, though quiet in the last two hours, logged four changes in six hours for a running total of thirty‑six. Godcrofts heated again with three flips in the last six hours, pushing its day‑total to twenty. Kings Cage showed two recent turns in six hours, while Farranac Coast, Fishermans Row, Callahans Passage and Stonecradle have gone silent in the past two hours. Casualty streams spiked sharply in the most recent hour across all active fronts, yet the two‑hour comparison shows cooling rates in Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Deadlands, Godcrofts and Kings Cage. Enlistment rates surged in the last hour at Callahans Passage and Kings Cage, modestly rose at Marban Hollow, but fell across Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Godcrofts, Deadlands, Farranac Coast and Linn Mercy. The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held south remain static with no base turnovers.
